classification_rule: broadcast if action_type in {shot, build-up} and shot_type != replay; filler if action_type == non-action or shot_type == replay. Goal times are NOT trusted from Gemini; cross-check against match_data / scoreboard timeline.

segments.description: An Arsenal player scores a goal from inside the penalty area.
Players line up on the pitch for pre-match ceremonies and handshakes.
A Chelsea player receives the ball in midfield and advances towards the opponent's half.
A Chelsea player scores a goal with a low shot past the goalkeeper.
Chelsea players celebrate their goal with the fans.
A replay shows the Chelsea player scoring the goal.
Chelsea players continue to celebrate their goal.
An Arsenal player receives a pass in the box and scores a goal.
A replay shows the Arsenal player scoring the goal.
Arsenal players celebrate their goal, followed by shots of the crowd and players preparing to restart.
An Arsenal player shoots and scores a goal from inside the penalty area.
A replay shows the Arsenal player scoring the goal.
Arsenal players celebrate their goal.
Another replay shows the Arsenal player scoring the goal from a different angle.
Arsenal players continue to celebrate their goal with the fans.
A third replay shows the Arsenal player scoring the goal.
Arsenal players celebrate, and the goalscorer receives a yellow card for removing his shirt.
Shots of the crowd cheering in the stadium.
Substitutions are made for both teams.
A Chelsea player walks off the pitch while the crowd is shown.
The final whistle blows, and players react on the pitch.
